summary: Yunhong Green CTI Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Fred H.F. Chak as Chairman of the Board, effective April 27, 2026, succeeding Gerald D. Roberts Jr., who served as interim Chairman since February 17, 2026. Roberts will continue as a director. No compensation terms, advisor, or share prices were disclosed. This is a board leadership transition, not a routine meeting notice. Watch for any subsequent strategic shifts under the new chairman.
